## Requirements

<a id="AdjustedBreath"></a>

### A phase set by the person

`AdjustedBreath` · `src/settings.ts:90` · status: **held**

A phase of the person's breath made longer or shorter by steps of half a second, kept within its bounds.

<details><summary>The rule, in the code</summary>

```typescript
({ b }) => (pattern: BreathPattern, phase: BreathPhase, steps: number): BreathPattern => {
    const least = phase === BreathPhase.inhale || phase === BreathPhase.exhale ? b.least : b.none
    return { ...pattern, [phase]: Math.min(b.most, Math.max(least, pattern[phase] + steps * b.step)) }
  }
```

</details>

- Owner: ghalaax
- Parameters: `b` ← [Bounds of a breath](#BreathBounds)
- Refines: [The breath sets the pace](product.md#BreathSetsThePace)
- Verified by: [The person's breath and voice](scenarios.md#PersonSettings)
- Used by: [Show the settings](#ShowSettings)

<a id="BreathWithinBounds"></a>

### A breath within its bounds

`BreathWithinBounds` · `src/settings.ts:63` · status: **held**

A breath the device kept is followed only within the bounds: a breath in and out of a second at least, holds from nothing, none longer than the most; another is no breath, and the default one is followed.

<details><summary>The rule, in the code</summary>

```typescript
({ b }) => (p: BreathPattern): boolean => {
    const within = (v: Duration, least: Duration) => v >= least && v <= b.most
    return within(p.inhale, b.least) && within(p.holdTop, b.none) && within(p.exhale, b.least) && within(p.holdBottom, b.none)
  }
```

</details>

- Owner: ghalaax
- Parameters: `b` ← [Bounds of a breath](#BreathBounds)
- Refines: [The breath sets the pace](product.md#BreathSetsThePace)
- Used by: [The person's breath](#PersonBreath)

<a id="MeasuredBreath"></a>

### A breath measured by tapping

`MeasuredBreath` · `src/settings.ts:128` · status: **held**

The person taps as each breath in starts and as each breath out starts: a breath in lasts, on average, from a tap to the next one, a breath out from that one to the following; no holds. Fewer than three taps measure nothing; the result is rounded to the step and kept within the bounds.

<details><summary>The rule, in the code</summary>

```typescript
({ b, tapping, counts }) => (taps: readonly number[]): BreathPattern | undefined => {
    if (counts.count(taps) < tapping.least) return undefined
    // From each tap to the next.
    const gapsOf = ([t, next, ...rest]: readonly number[]): number[] => (next === undefined ? [] : [next - t, ...gapsOf([next, ...rest])])
    const gaps = gapsOf(taps)
    // The gaps alternate: a breath in, then a breath out.
    const split = ([first, second, ...rest]: readonly number[]): [number[], number[]] => {
      if (first === undefined) return [[], []]
      const [ins, outs] = split(rest)
      return [[first, ...ins], second === undefined ? outs : [second, ...outs]]
    }
    const mean = (xs: number[]) => xs.reduce((a, x) => a + x, counts.zero) / counts.count(xs)
    const fit = (v: number): Duration => Math.min(b.most, Math.max(b.least, Math.round(v / b.step) * b.step)) as Duration
    const [ins, outs] = split(gaps)
    return { inhale: fit(mean(ins)), holdTop: b.none, exhale: fit(mean(outs)), holdBottom: b.none }
  }
```

</details>

- Owner: ghalaax
- Parameters: `b` ← [Bounds of a breath](#BreathBounds) · `tapping` ← [Tapping](#Tapping) · `counts` ← [Counts](../.trame/std/docs/algebra.md#Counts)
- Refines: [The breath sets the pace](product.md#BreathSetsThePace)
- Verified by: [The person's breath and voice](scenarios.md#PersonSettings)
- Used by: [Show the settings](#ShowSettings)

## Decisions

<a id="BreathBounds"></a>

### Bounds of a breath

`BreathBounds` · `src/settings.ts:28`

A phase is set half a second at a time; a breath in or out lasts at least a second, a hold may last nothing, and none lasts more than twenty seconds.

| Case | Value |
|---|---|
| step | 500 ms |
| least | 1 s |
| most | 20 s |
| none | 0 h |

- Decided by: ghalaax
- Used by: [A phase set by the person](#AdjustedBreath), [A breath within its bounds](#BreathWithinBounds), [A breath measured by tapping](#MeasuredBreath)
